name: Pricing Model
description: The product's overall monetization type (Freemium, Open Source, Paid Subscription).

name: Free Tier
description: Availability of a fully free plan for personal use.

name: Personal: Monthly
description: Cost of one month's subscription for a single personal user.

name: Personal: Annual
description: Cost of an individual subscription when billed annually.

name: Team / Business: Monthly
description: Monthly cost for a team or small business plan.

name: Team / Business: Annual
description: Cost of a team subscription when billed annually.

name: Enterprise
description: A plan for large organizations, with custom features, dedicated servers, and 24/7 support.
